Game Overview

BFFs Summer Aesthetic puts players into a dress up experience centered on mix and match vibrant summer outfits, trendy hairstyles, and chic accessories to style six fabulous BFFs for their worldwide adventures. Embrace the dreamy aesthetics, delight in creating coordinated looks, and celebrate friendship through fashion with intuitive gameplay that's both fun and expressive.

The moment-to-moment gameplay in BFFs Summer Aesthetic is easy to pick up.
